summary: The name of the certificate used to sign emails using S/MIME (Secure/MIME) as it is registered in the system Certificate store (*keychain*)
description:
The .certificateName property contains the name of the certificate used to sign emails using S/MIME (Secure/MIME) as it is registered in the system Certificate store (keychain). This certificate contains the private key.

The certificate can also be provided directly as a file or blob using the .certificate property. Note that you cannot use both properties simultaneously, otherwise an error is returned.
